rounds.text: While the headline growth figures appear attractive, the structural warning signs within the evidence reveal severe underlying risks. Promoter holding has experienced a notable liquidation, dropping from 70.00% in September 2023 to 57.69% in June 2026, alongside a further decrease over the last quarter [E27, E49]. This continuous insider divestment directly contradicts the narrative of long-term conviction. Furthermore, operational efficiency has severely deteriorated, evidenced by working capital days exploding from 552 days to an alarming 1,586 days [E50]. Compounding these operational distress signals, the stock carries a catastrophic historical vulnerability, having suffered a worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -88.0% [E38]. Additionally, the company currently offers a dividend yield of exactly 0.00%, depriving shareholders of any immediate cash return while they absorb this extreme volatility [E4]. Conceded: the company displays a low P/E of 4.94x and strong recent profit growth [E1, E47].
